validate.title: Validating UniFi Cloud Key
validate.instruction: Please set the Cloud Key in Settings first.

notConfigured.title: App is not configured yet
notConfigured.protect: The UniFi Protect connection has not been set up yet. Open the app settings and enter the IP address of your UniFi console plus a Protect V2 API key or a local username and password.
notConfigured.access: The UniFi Access connection has not been set up yet. Open the app settings and enter the IP address of your UniFi console plus a UniFi Access API key.
notConfigured.steps: Go to Homey → Apps → UniFi Protect → Settings. The setup wizard starts automatically as long as nothing is configured, and guides you step by step.

rtsp.title: RTSP stream not enabled
rtsp.warning_camera: The cameras below have no RTSP(S) stream shared in UniFi Protect. You can still add them — motion and smart detection keep working — but live video will not be available until you enable the stream.
rtsp.warning_doorbell: The doorbells below have no RTSP(S) stream shared in UniFi Protect. You can still add them — motion, ringing and smart detection keep working — but live video will not be available until you enable the stream.

settings.title: UniFi Protect Settings
settings.instruction: Log in with the credentials of the UniFi Protect user.
settings.accessInstruction: Connect to UniFi Access with an API key. This connection is configured separately from the UniFi Protect settings.
settings.ignoreEventsNfcFingerprint: Cooldown period between NFC/Fingerprint events (in seconds)
settings.ignoreEventsDoorbell: Cooldown period between Doorbell events (in seconds)
settings.protectV2ApiKeyDescription: Beta: connect using a V2 API key. Works completely independently of the V1 credentials.
settings.protectV2CloudDisclaimer: Cloud API uses REST only in this app. WebSockets and realtime device/event updates do not work in cloud mode.
settings.protectV2Instruction: Connect to UniFi Protect with a V2 API key. This connection is configured separately from the V1 credentials.

wizard.title: Setup wizard
wizard.restartHint: Reopens the wizard with your current settings filled in. Nothing is deleted.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: This wizard connects Homey to your UniFi console. Keep the UniFi web interface open in another tab — you will need it to create an account or API key. Nothing is saved until the last step.

choose.title: Choose a connection
choose.body: Pick one or more connections. You can always add the others later on the tabs.
choose.error: Select at least one connection to continue.
choose.v2desc: Modern REST API with realtime events, using an integration API key.
choose.v1desc: Local UniFi OS account. Needed for the NVR Alarm Manager and some older devices.
choose.accessdesc: Only needed for UniFi Access doors, readers, intercoms and hubs.

server.title: UniFi console
server.body: Enter the local IP address of your UniFi console, for example 192.168.1.1. The default ports are filled in automatically.
server.error: Enter the IP address of your UniFi console.

v1.title: Protect V1 — local user
v1.intro: Create a dedicated local UniFi OS account for Homey. Do not use your personal admin account.
v1.s1: Open https://__ip__ in your browser and log in as administrator.
v1.s2: Go to UniFi OS → Users → Admins.
v1.s3: Click Add Admin and enable 'Restrict to local access only'.
v1.s4: Give the account access to UniFi Protect, with at least the Limited Admin role.
v1.s5: Click Add, then enter the username and password below.
v1.error: Enter both a username and a password.

v2.title: Protect V2 — API key
v2.intro: Create an integration API key in UniFi Protect.
v2.s1: Open https://__ip__ in your browser and log in.
v2.s2: Open UniFi Protect and go to Settings (gear icon, bottom left).
v2.s4: Click Add New Integration and name it 'Homey'.
v2.s5: Copy the API key — it is shown only once — and paste it below.
v2.cloudError: Enter the Console ID when using the Cloud API.

access.title: UniFi Access — API key
access.intro: Create an integration API key in UniFi Access.
access.s1: Open https://__ip__ in your browser and log in.
access.s2: Open UniFi Access and go to Settings → Integrations → Local Access.
access.s3: Click Add New Integration and name it 'Homey'.
access.s4: Copy the API key — it is shown only once — and paste it below.

test.fail: Connection failed. Check the details, or continue and fix it later.

summary.title: Ready to save
summary.saved: Setup complete. The app is connecting now.

warnings.unifi_access: Warning: UniFi Access features are in early beta. Use with caution and report any issues to the developer.
warnings.no_rtsp_url: Warning: No RTSP URL available for this camera. Please Enable 'Share Livestream' -> 'Enable Secure RTSPS Output' in the camera settings in UniFi Protect to use livestream features. Instructions: https://github.com/steffjenl/com-homey-unifiprotect/blob/develop/wiki/rtsp-setup.md

msg.controller_unreachable: Controller unreachable. Check IP address in settings.
msg.repair_controller_unreachable: Update controller IP address and try again.

notification.controller_error_body: Controller at {ip}:{port} is not responding. Check your network and IP configuration.
